title: Iron-based biological chemistry
basic_overview: Iron supports O₂ binding, electron transfer and catalysis through Fe²⁺/Fe³⁺ chemistry and diverse ligand environments.

extra_info_content.short_trick: Fe function depends on OS + ligands + geometry.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Assign OS. 2. Determine d count. 3. Identify ligand environment. 4. Connect redox/coordination to function.
extra_info_content.factors: Heme and non-heme iron centres have different ligand sets and reactivity.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
